title: Homelab wiki
intro: What each Dockfire surface is for. Health checks are DNS resolve + TCP from the cluster; admin links open the management UI. No credentials are stored in Dockfire.

entries.name: Proxmox
entries.summary: Primary hypervisor cluster for VMs and LXCs.
used_for: Run guest VMs and containers that back app workloads
Snapshots, live migration, and node maintenance
Storage attachment for guests (local / shared)

entries.name: PegaProx
entries.summary: Helper UI around the Proxmox cluster.
used_for: Faster cluster-oriented views than the stock PVE UI
Day-2 operations convenience for Proxmox hosts

entries.name: Proxmox Datacenter Manager
entries.summary: Upstream PDM control plane for multi-node Proxmox.
used_for: Central management across Proxmox nodes
Fleet-style visibility for the compute layer

entries.name: iDRAC
entries.summary: Dell out-of-band management processors on bare-metal hosts.
used_for: Power control, console, and hardware health when the OS is down
Firmware and hardware alerting independent of the hypervisor

entries.name: TrueNAS
entries.summary: Primary NAS for datasets, shares, and block storage.
used_for: NFS/iSCSI/SMB for clusters and workstations
Dataset snapshots and replication jobs
Backing volumes used by Kubernetes CSI where applicable

entries.name: NAS / RustFS
used_for: App and backup object buckets
GitOps / CNPG style object destinations when configured

entries.name: Proxmox Backup
entries.summary: PBS appliance for guest and host backups.
used_for: Proxmox guest backup jobs
Retention and restore of VM/LXC images

entries.name: Rancher
entries.summary: Cluster manager for RKE2 / downstream clusters.
used_for: Create and manage Kubernetes clusters
Fleet GitOps targeting (prd-apps and friends)
Access control and cluster inventory

entries.name: Harbor
used_for: Store cluster images (library/* and mirrors)
Scan and replicate images used by GitOps deploys

entries.name: Coder
entries.summary: Workspace control plane for humans and coding agents.
used_for: Ephemeral or persistent IDE workspaces
Agent berths used by slashbay-style dispatch

entries.name: Authentik
entries.summary: SSO identity provider for lab apps.
used_for: Single sign-on into internal UIs
OIDC/SAML for apps that support it

entries.name: Pulseblade
entries.summary: Agent-first infrastructure monitor with gated remediation.
used_for: Fleet health, findings, and change journals
MCP surface for agents; human dashboard for triage

entries.name: Grafana
used_for: Time-series views across hosts and clusters
Showpiece graphs for capacity and saturation

entries.name: Dockfire
entries.summary: This page: coarse health plus deep links.
used_for: One glance at whether admin surfaces answer TCP
Jump straight into the right UI when something is red

entries.name: UniFi
entries.summary: LAN / WLAN controller (gateway or UniFi OS).
used_for: Wi-Fi, switching, and LAN firewall policy
Client and uplink visibility for the home/lab network

entries.name: PDU
entries.summary: Rack power distribution with a network management card.
used_for: Outlet power state and load
Remote power cycle for stubborn hardware (carefully)

notes: Dockfire never stores passwords, tokens, or API keys.
Reachability is resolve+TCP from the cluster path — not a full app login test.
LAN-only endpoints (raw RFC1918 admin URLs) stay out of the public git tree and are mounted at deploy time when needed.
